source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
After this model finishes shooting in your Shooting phase, each enemy unit hit by 1 or more of its **[[INDIRECT FIRE]](vsdata:weapon-ability/indirect-fire)** weapon attacks takes a Battle-shock test.

Whenever one of those attacks destroys an enemy model with **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)**, that model's Deadly Demise causes mortal wounds on a 5+ rather than only a 6.

effects.appliesTo: each enemy unit hit by 1 or more of this model's Indirect Fire weapon attacks

effects.trigger: one of those Indirect Fire attacks destroys an enemy model with Deadly Demise
